description: This is a Java source file defining an Android ListActivity with an efficient custom adapter for displaying a list with icons and text, demonstrating view recycling and ViewHolder pattern.

classes.name: List14
classes.description: Main activity that extends ListActivity, setting a custom adapter.

classes.name: EfficientAdapter
classes.description: Custom list adapter that uses ViewHolder pattern and reuses views for efficiency.

classes.name: ViewHolder
classes.description: Inner static class for holding references to views within a list item.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the custom adapter.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the data source array.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the data object for the specified position (here, just the index).

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID for the item, here the position index.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a list item view, binds data to it, employing the ViewHolder pattern for efficiency.
